_comment: Pick the canonical styleKey for each conflicting typography class. Key = cssClass (body-1) or Figma base name (Body/Body-1). Value = full styleKey from json/font-style-overrides.json. Keys starting with _ are ignored, so this file is a no-op until you move an entry out of _suggested. Re-run npm run extract && npm run tokens after editing.
_note: You only need a pick when you disagree with the resolver. Since tokens are scoped to the shipped pages and variants are ranked by node usage, every conflict below already has a clear plurality winner and strict resolve passes with no picks at all.
